# @adhd/apigen-cli — LLM summary

## Identity
- npm: @adhd/apigen-cli (0.1.0) — bin: `apigen`
- Source: entrypoint/apigen-cli/ in adhd monorepo
- License: MIT
- Build: npx nx build apigen-cli

## Commands
- `apigen run --source <path> --type <plugin-id> [--opt key=value] [--use <plugin>] [--v2]` — Serve source as live server
- `apigen generate --source <path> --type <plugin-id> --out-dir <path> [options]` — Generate artifacts to disk
- `apigen serve --source <path> [--source ...] --port <port> [--mount ns=plugin]` — Multi-source front server
- `apigen run-registry --packages-dir <path> --type <plugin-id> [options]` — Multi-package live server
- `apigen generate-registry --packages-dir <path> --type <plugin-id> --out-dir <path> [options]` — Multi-package generate

## Plugin types (--type)
mcp, jsonschema, api-fastify, api-express, cli/cli-output, py-flask, py-grpc

## Built-in --use plugins
health, logger (plus custom by package specifier or local path)

## Key flags (all commands)
- --log-level (APIGEN_LOG_LEVEL): trace|debug|info|warn|error|fatal|silent
- --log-format (APIGEN_LOG_FORMAT): json|pretty
- --log-file (APIGEN_LOG_FILE): path
- --v2: use unified orchestrator path
- --config: projection-override config file (Tenet 1)

## Sources
- CLI entry: src/index.ts (Commander.js)
- Command implementations: src/lib/commands/{run,generate,serve,run-registry,generate-registry}.ts
- Pipeline: src/lib/pipeline.ts (v1), src/lib/orchestrator.ts (v2)
- Scaffolding: src/lib/scaffold.ts
- Registry discovery: src/lib/registry.ts
- Tsconfig resolution: src/lib/resolve-tsconfig.ts
- Dynamic import: src/lib/import-source.ts
- Logging: src/lib/logging.ts
